# Kodehelix

> Kodehelix is a website design and development studio based in Lucknow, India. It builds fast, mobile-first business websites, web apps and AI tools for businesses in India and abroad, and runs a UI store of animated components and dashboard templates in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Contact: WhatsApp or call +91 70070 64653, email adityaps700@gmail.com. Website: https://kodehelix.in/

## Services and prices (fixed quotes, exclude 18% GST in India)
- Launch website: from ₹10,000 ($499 abroad). 1–5 pages, custom design, WhatsApp/call/map buttons, enquiry form, basic SEO. 7–10 days.
- Business website: from ₹39,999 ($1,499). 8–15 pages, admin panel, booking or enquiry flows, SEO and Google Business Profile. 3–4 weeks.
- Commerce: from ₹89,999 ($3,499). Online store or booking system, Razorpay/Cashfree/Stripe, up to 100 products. 4–6 weeks.
- Platform & AI: from ₹2,49,999 ($7,999). Logins, dashboards, subscriptions, AI agents and automation. Billed by milestone.
- Care plan ₹5,000/month; Growth plan (adds monthly SEO) ₹10,000/month.
- Process: free 30-minute call, fixed quote within 24 hours, homepage design approved before the full build, 50% to start and 50% before launch.
